description: This Java class 'TbAlarmCountSubCtx' manages alarm count subscriptions within the Thingsboard platform, including fetching alarm data, rate-limited alarm count queries, and WebSocket subscription handling.

classes.name: TbAlarmCountSubCtx
classes.description: Manages alarm count subscriptions, data fetching, and WebSocket updates for alarm counts.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches entity data based on the query's entity filter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the alarm count by fetching latest data.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Indicates that this subscription context is dynamic.

methods.name: fetchAlarmCount
methods.description: Fetches the current alarm count with rate limiting.

methods.name: doFetchAlarmCount
methods.description: Immediately fetches the alarm count and sends WebSocket message.

methods.name: buildEntityDataQuery
methods.description: Builds the entity data query for fetching entities.

methods.name: resetInvocationCounter
methods.description: Resets the alarm count invocation attempts counter.

methods.name: createAlarmSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates WebSocket alarm subscriptions for each entity.

methods.name: createAlarmSubscriptionForEntity
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket alarm subscription for a specific entity.
